_comment: Single-ended ring amplifier (BAG ringamp_se): the PMOS tail, input, enable and second stage; the PMOS charge, enable, dead-zone and output devices (the dead-zone device between the second stage's and the output device it joins); their NMOS counterparts; the NMOS tail, input, feedback, enable and second stage. Netlist (per PDK): written by flow.ringamp.subckt (se).
